cocktail.name: Division Bell
preparation: Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice and shake until well-chilled
Strain into a chilled coupe glass
Express the oils from a grapefruit twist over the drink, then discard the twist
cocktail.description: The Division Bell is an update to the gin-based Last Word the substitutes mezcal for gin and Aperol for Green Chartreuse. Created by Phil Ward (who also created the Oaxaca Old Fashioned) for Mayahuel as part of a push to add 20 tequila and mezcal drinks on the menu.

albums.title: Incesticide
albums.label: DGC Records
albums.notes: The songs that became Incesticide started as a catalog of unreleased songs still owned by Sub Pop records. Collection of b-sides, covers and outtakes. Four different drummers (Chad Channing, Dan Peters, Dale Clover and Dave Grohl). Many songs point to Nirvana's more punk early influences.

albums.title: A Black Mile to the Surface
albums.recorded: Echo Mountain Recording, Elmwood West, Favorite Gentlemen, The Village
albums.label: Loma Vista
albums.notes: Fifth studio album. Cohesive record that interweaves reflections on lead singer's newborn daughter with concept around a small mining town in South Dakota. Shifted to concept album format after working on Swiss Army Man soundtrack. Moved away from post-hardcore sounds with more organic, Americana sounds.

albums.title: In Rainbows
albums.recorded: Halswell House (Somerset), Tottenham House (Wiltshire), The Hospital Club (London), Radiohead's studio (Oxfordshire)
albums.label: Self released through XL and TBD (North America)
albums.notes: Seventh studio album. Self-released without prior notice under Pay-What-You-Want model. Released after three-year hiatus following Hail to the Thief tour. Failed attempt with producer Spike Stent led to management suggesting band break-up; band toured instead which pressured them to finish. Continues layering and electronic influence of Kid A and Amnesiac but with more warmth and less dystopian lyrical content.
